results.title: Jói
results.overview: Jói, an innocent, simple shopkeeper gets accused of a horrific, unspecified crime by a judge, a cop, a prison officer and two mysterious men and must fight for his right to live.

results.title: The Look of Art
results.overview: A man is stranden on the road and takes refuge in a cabin. At dawn, he realizes that he was never alone.

results.title: 40 Watts from Nowhere
results.overview: Frustrated by commercial radio in the ’90s, a music-loving legal secretary builds one from scratch and runs it out of her LA apartment.

results.title: Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger formation lap: Settlers of the Galaxy
results.original_title: 爆上戦隊ブンブンジャー formation lap 始末屋 オブ ギャラクシー
results.overview: Before Sakito and Byun Diesel return to Earth as seen in Bakuage Sentai Boonboomger's 16th episode, "Purple Settler", we witness this universe-spanning tale of the Settler duo, Sakito Homura and Byun Diesel, before their return to Earth after over a decade of absence.

results.title: Crown of Shadows
results.overview: The Kingdom of Aberon has fallen into darkness under Queen Ginnarra's reign since she murdered the King. Exiled and hunted, her brother Prince Elderon joins a rebellion, summoning a dragon to defeat the Queen and the Dark Gods she serves.

results.title: Mudrasta: Ang Beking Ina
results.overview: Victor "Beki" Labrador and Enrique Santillanes were once high-school sweethearts. Years later, Beki is shocked to discover that Enrique's final will grants him half of the estate and control of the family business— with one outrageous condition: he must move into a mansion and live with Enrique's orphanes sons and their sharp-tongued grandmother. What more could possibly go wrong?

results.title: The Ritual House
results.overview: Two friends' attempt to rescue the home from financial ruin by renting out rooms which turns into a nightmare as the guests uncover the house's dark, ritual-filled past.

results.title: Dateless to Dangerous: My Son's Secret Life
results.original_title: Dateless to Dangerous: My Son's Secret Life
results.overview: The start of a new school year brings unexpected challenges for siblings Miles and Haley Miller as they navigate dramatic changes in their lives. Their newly separated mother Noelle works tirelessly to provide for her family while adjusting to their new reality. In an effort to bond with her brother, Haley coaches Miles through his romantic pursuits, only for him to face public humiliation. As sibling tensions rise, Noelle begins to notice troubling changes in her son – anger, isolation, and hostility toward her, Haley and friends at school. After yet another crushing rejection, Miles spirals into the toxic world of incels–a dark and shadowy online underworld that fuels his growing resentment. As he slips further into darkness, Noelle and Haley race against time to save him, desperate to reach him before he’s consumed completely.

results.title: The Wayward Bird
results.overview: Sangjae, a janitor at a university, finds solace in birdwatching, his one and only hobby. However, when a new campus building is constructed, its glass facade becomes a death trap for migratory birds. One day, he notices Tom, an older janitor, quietly placing stickers on the windows to prevent further fatal collisions.

results.title: Bear
results.overview: On her birthday, Lizzie, a successful publishing editor, faces a career-threatening crisis at work. On her way home, an unexpected act of violence changes the course of her life forever. What begins as an ordinary day quietly leads to an irreversible ending.

results.title: Selection
results.overview: Xiaowei took his son Yangyang to a football club tryout, hoping to secure a better future for him. However, having just arrived in Japan, he struggled with the language and was introverted, leading to clashes with other young players.

results.title: The Uniformed
results.overview: At 18, a young man commits to 17 years in the military. Inside the system, he witnesses things he hadn't thought possible.

results.title: Crash Out
results.overview: A hot tempered college student crashes out on her quest for revenge after her nemesis steals her slides during a group presentation

results.title: Renascence
results.overview: Selene, a university student, meets the boy of her dreams in class. Everything seems to be going perfect however things start to go awry when she makes a horrifying discovery...

results.title: Assalamualaikum Beijing 2: Lost in Ningxia
results.overview: Aisha thought she had found happiness with Arif, a figure who perfectly complemented her life. Making her not hesitate to remove all obstacles, even the most difficult ones, to prove how great her love was. In fact, the love that Aisha believed in not only gave her wings to fly high, but also dropped her from the highest place, taking her to wander the jungle without a clear goal. Making her ask, Have the decisions she has made so far been right? Where will her love find its estuary? Truly God is All-Good, the journey through Ningxia made Aisha realize that time is another form of His goodness. And the most important part is not the beginning, but the end. Always the end.
